items.title: Arvind KC appointed Chief People Officer
items.summary: OpenAI appoints Arvind KC as Chief People Officer to help scale the company, strengthen its culture, and lead how work evolves in the age of AI.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI任命Arvind KC为首席人事官，负责公司文化建设与组织规模化发展。此变动属于企业管理范畴。
